Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.TribeCard
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.CharacterCard
Direct Known Subclasses:
Artist, Builder, Collector, Hunter, Inventor, Shaman
public abstract class CharacterCard extends TribeCard
Abstract base class for all character (tribe) cards.

Character cards are drawn from the tribe deck and added to a player's collection. Each card has a CharacterType, a tag value representing the minimum player count required for the card to be available, and optional special abilities (prestige contribution, shaman stars, inventions, etc.).
